description: This file defines a report for income tax deductions in the ERPNext system, including functions to generate report columns, filter conditions, and retrieve data related to employee income tax components, specifically tailored for the Indian region.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the income tax deductions report, including conditional columns based on region.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL WHERE clause conditions based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and compiles income tax deduction data for employees, including region-specific details.
